name: latex
description: 在用户指定的工作区里读取、修改并编译 LaTeX。工作区目录必填，没有默认路径，未填写时保持 setup_required。安装不等于已经编译。本包不是 Kimi 原包。

workspace.title: WEB_LATEX_MCP_WORKSPACE
workspace.description: Required project workspace directory. No default. Do not use a home directory, drive root, or the upstream ${HOME}/latex-workspace default. Unset disables this MCP server.
